name: Igor Shegolev
biography: I’m Igor Shegolev, a software engineer at Wix, based in Tel Aviv. I build developer tools and infrastructure for coding agents — the runtimes they run in and the control planes that keep their work on track. Mostly TypeScript, sometimes Rust.
